title: ArduPilot EKF3 source-set switch under GPS denial
summary: Flies ArduCopter SITL on GPS, switches EKF3 to an external-nav source set (SITL vicon) with MAV_CMD_SET_EKF_SOURCE_SET or an RC aux switch, cuts simulated GPS, keeps flying, then restores it. EKF_STATUS_REPORT is logged throughout, decoded by a stdlib module with unit tests.
verified: ekf_flags.py and test_ekf_flags.py ran with python3.14.7 stdlib on 2026-11-06 (6 tests OK), output shown in README. source_switch.py is an unverified sketch: syntax-checked only, requires pymavlink and ArduPilot SITL (sim_vehicle.py with the vicon simulator); parameter names were checked against ArduPilot master and the ArduPilot-4.6 branch source on 2026-11-06.
